messages:
anya: Quick sync — proposal for next week’s PLG push. Combine a short LinkedIn launch post + a 45-min webinar. Hypothesis: outcome-led narrative with 3 concise benchmarks will drive higher activation than feature-led. Plan: A/B creative, route inbound signups into two onboarding flows, each with different prompt templates and starter credits nudges. Thoughts?
matt: Love the experiment. Suggest we surface 3 KPIs: 1) webinar->signup rate, 2) signup->activated-within-48h, 3) avg tokens in first 3 sessions. Can analytics stand up a lightweight dashboard?
lucy: Copy idea — outcome-led: 'Ship LLM features with predictable latency & cost.' Feature-led: 'One inference runtime across hosted, dedicated, private.' CTA options: 'Claim starter credits' vs 'Book a workshop'.
sam_grow: Prefer the credits CTA for PLG. Routing plan: add utm_experiment=benchA|benchB to registration links and auto-assign cohort. I'll wire the registration page. Ops — can you create the routing rule?
ops-bot: Routing rule queued. Example config snippet: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/route -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"{{email}}","utm":"benchA"}'
``` -> assigns user.cohort=benchA. :white_check_mark:
anya: Timeline ask: lucy drafts 2 short posts + webinar blurb by EOD tomorrow; matt/analytics stands up dashboard; sam, confirm routing + lead follow-up SLA (within 4h).
matt: Putting a dashboard mock in /drive/marketing/bench-web-05/dashboard-v1.png. I'll track activation, token velocity, first-7-day retention. Will add cohort filters.
lucy: Drafts in thread: [postA] Outcome-led: 'Build fast, ship cheaper: Redwood Inference helps teams serve LLMs reliably at scale. Join our live demo + claim starter credits.' [postB] Feature-led: 'One API. Multiple deployments. Consistent latency. Try Redwood free.' Webinar blurb: 'Live demo + cost-saving playbook — Wed 10am PT. Seats limited.'
sam_grow: For SDR follow-up: trigger when signup has company email + >=1k tokens in 7 days. Send to #sales-inbound with profile + cohort. SLA: first touch <=4h.
anya: Also include a prompt-templates pack as the onboarding artifact for the credits funnel. Lucy — can you assemble 3 starter templates (assistant, retrieval, summary) and tag them by cohort in the repo /docs/prompt-templates/bench-web-05?
lucy: On it. Quick templates I’ll add: 1) Customer-support summarizer 2) Product-launch email generator 3) Knowledge-base Q&A starter. Will include short examples for each.
matt: Analytics note — please emit events: 'prompt_template_download' and 'first_prompt_run' with property 'cohort' so we can attribute activation.
ops-bot: Tracking snippet example: <script>track('first_prompt_run',{cohort:'benchA'});</script> — include in onboarding flow.
anya: Proposed timeline: creative drafts EOD tomorrow, routing + tagging live Mon morning, dashboard Mon noon, webinar Wed 10am PT. Any blockers?
lucy: Need calendar invite with presenters — can someone create and add speakers? I’ll own the creative.
sam_grow: I’ll set up the registration page and auto-assign utm tags. SDR will own follow-ups.
matt: No blockers from analytics side. :rocket:
anya: Great. Keeping this thread as single source. Ping here if anything slips or if copy needs a quick review. :thumbsup:
